J&K Assembly Adjourned Amid Protests Over Power, Jobs

The Jammu and Kashmir Assembly was adjourned until the next day due to protests and a ruckus. The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) demonstrated over issues including a power hike and unemployment. The adjournment occurred amid the din created by the protests.
